name: superdesign
description: Design and build brand-specific UI with React 19 + Tailwind v4 + shadcn/ui through a system-first workflow: brand -> art-direction brief -> OKLCH tokens -> a vetted pattern cookbook -> polish -> anti-slop, accessibility and rendered-geometry gates that exit non-zero. Includes reference mining: measure a real product's design and prove your output differentiated from it. A design-system generator rather than a fixed theme, aimed at output that looks deliberately designed instead of AI-generated.
